segments.comment: Penniless variation of kick-shop-door-pay-damage-5520005: an independent seed found by scanning seeds 4410000-4410029 with the port for a D:3 shop whose door is closed. A Valkyrie starts with no gold. After the wizard-mode level teleport, Ctrl-T places the hero at (10,16), east of the closed door at (9,16). The second kick west lets kick_door() succeed: the door crashes open, add_damage() bills SHOP_DOOR_COST, and pay_for_damage() brings the shopkeeper to the door. The hero cannot pay 400 zorkmids, so getcad() angers the shopkeeper, who zaps a wand and misses.
